_doc: Phượng Minh Cung: Trúc Cơ. Nguyên Anh, Kết Đan and the dead in phuong_minh.cast.json; Luyện Khí in phuong_minh.3.cast.json.

people.gloss: A dawn wish; the phoenix's stately coming
people.role: The head's youngest disciple; the only Light root in the palace
people.appearance: A slight young woman with a market girl's quick eyes, who holds her head tilted as if listening for something behind the room.
people.backstory: Chúc Hiểu Nghi was born in 1170 over a flute-maker's shop in Thiều Âm Thị, to one of the families that came back to the market when the founder opened it (A238) and that claim Vân Môn blood. Fire is rare on the market's Metal ground; the family says it is the blood. She came to the outer gate at twelve on her Fire and took the Feather Kindling at nineteen. The feather burned white instead of red, and the Nest found Light in her root, the only Light in the palace. In 1195 her elder brother, a market flute player, played a tune no one had taught him and every bird on the ridge fell silent (A248); the elders paid his passage far away. A year later Hoa Triêu Dương (hoa_trieu_duong) took Chúc as her disciple and brought her down to the Fire Court. Chúc believes her brother is somewhere across the gulf, because Lộ Văn Khánh (lo_van_khanh) tells her so, and she keeps the flute he left behind. She sleeps in the room next to the head's. On some nights, through the wall, she hears her brother's tune in the head's breathing.
people.wants: To find her brother, and to learn why the head chose her.
people.secret: She has worked out that the Tiêu Thiều Quản is Light, that she is the palace's only Light, and that the tune in the head's breathing is the Shao. She has told no one, not even Bạc Địch Thanh.

people.role: The grand elder's last disciple; a fan duelist
people.appearance: Long-limbed and restless, with chrysanthemums painted on his fan and ink on his cuffs from poems he does not show anyone.
people.backstory: Du Diễm Ca was born in 1155 in Cúc Viên Thôn, whose villagers hid Phượng Minh's scouts among the chrysanthemums in 586 (A303) and which has sent a child to the palace in every generation since. He was the outer gate's fastest fan at sixteen. In 1185 Nhiếp Tẫn Sa (nhiep_tan_sa) took him as his last disciple, the first in a hundred years, and on his first night at the Nest told him the whole of Cô Thành: the riders, the note, the sword in the Hall of Spoils (N-phuong_minh-05, N-phuong_minh-06). Du has believed since that the palace's honour hangs in that hall. He has heard that a Băng Tâm swordswoman, Hạ Lăng Hàn (ha_lang_han), has sworn to take the sword back by duel, and he has written to her under a false name as a Phượng Minh disciple who agrees with her. She writes back. Every month he duels Đằng Phi Diễm (dang_phi_diem) for the top step of the Fire Court's stair, and loses one in three.
people.wants: To be the one who carries the Red Plum to Băng Tâm, and to meet Hạ Lăng Hàn with an open hand rather than a closed fan.
people.secret: Four letters each way since 1196, signed Cúc (Chrysanthemum). In the last one he told her where in the Hall of Spoils the sword hangs.

people.role: Sử Hoành Dực's daughter; second at the vein fort of Đan Sơn Mạch
people.appearance: Her father's build and her mother's calm, with her mother's old hairpin worn every day.
people.backstory: Born at the Fire Court and raised in the vein fort, Sử Niệm Huỳnh was twenty-six when Cố Dạ Lan killed her mother Dụ Đan Huỳnh (du_dan_huynh) on Đan Sơn Mạch (N-phuong_minh-10). Her father Sử Hoành Dực (su_hoanh_duc) has lived for the revenge since. She wants none of it. She serves under her mother's disciple Hách Chu Lăng (hach_chu_lang), and writes to Trình Hi Quang (trinh_hi_quang) about the peace, though she does not know how far his talks have gone.

people.role: Steward of the outer gate; plays the dawn flute and holds the Feather Kindling
people.appearance: A bent, smiling old man with a stonemason's hands and a bamboo flute worn smooth at the holes.
people.backstory: A stonemason's son from Thạch Tượng Thôn, the village the quarrymen built after Xích Thành fired their town (V164), Mao Khải Đán has played the dawn flute at the Fire Court for a hundred years and has held the Feather Kindling for every outer disciple since. He never reached Kết Đan and has sixty years left. Điền Phong Niên (dien_phong_nien) made him steward. Half the inner gate learned to breathe from him.

people.role: Bird keeper of the Wutong Court
people.appearance: A quiet woman in green with a blue-backed spirit bird that never leaves her collar.
people.backstory: A longan farmer's daughter from Quế Viên Thôn, An Thúy Vũ has kept the red-crested messengers for Vu Ngô Đồng (vu_ngo_dong) for sixty years. She is the only one who has seen him at night with both palms on the great wutong's trunk and the bark warm under them, and she has worked out what it costs him. She has not said so. She is Ổ Linh Tước's (o_linh_tuoc) senior in the aviary.

people.role: Envoy of the Hall of Trust to the northern sects
people.appearance: A long, courteous man with a port-city accent and the cleanest hand in the palace.
people.backstory: A harbour clerk's son from the port of Tang Điền, Thư Ngạn Hành carries the Hall of Trust's letters north for Vưu Cẩm Thư (vuu_cam_thu): to the Pivot, to Băng Tâm, to the caravan towns of the Desert Road. He and Băng Tâm's envoy Ngụy Thanh Hàn (nguy_thanh_han) have shared inns for forty years and have never discussed Cô Thành. He has been told there is nothing in the Hall of Spoils that belongs to Băng Tâm.

people.role: The inner gate's best fan; holds the top step of the stair
people.appearance: Tall, red-haired from the vent and unsmiling, with not one burn on her sleeves.
people.backstory: Ash-born and pure Fire, Đằng Phi Diễm has held the top step of the Fire Court's stair for eleven years, and her sleeves have no burns on them. Thích Hồng Linh (thich_hong_linh) calls her the best fan she has taught. She thinks Du Diễm Ca (du_diem_ca) wastes his talent on poems and grudges that are not his, and she intends to go to Kết Đan before him.

people.role: Hùng Phần Vũ's daughter, a ward of the palace since she was twelve
people.appearance: Thick-armed and short-haired, with the burn-mottled skin of the vents under her inner-gate red.
people.backstory: Hùng Phần Vũ (hung_phan_vu) sent his daughter to the palace at twelve, as every head of Phần Vũ Đường must, and the palace has kept her as a ward for thirty-eight years. Thích Hồng Linh (thich_hong_linh) teaches her the fan. At night she slips out to the vents four tiles away and tempers with her father's disciples, which the palace forbids its own people. She is the hall's surety, and she knows it.

people.role: Tang Kế Ti's son; carries silk between the Nest and Chức Hà Các
people.appearance: A good-looking, easy man who always has a fire-silk scarf that is not quite the palace's colour.
people.backstory: The array keeper's son, Tang Tục Lạc was meant to keep the Nest after his mother Tang Kế Ti (tang_ke_ti) and has no gift for it. What he has is a road: every month he rides to Chức Hà Các and comes back with vent-less silk for her splices and with the head of Chức Hà, Thân Vân Cẩm (than_van_cam), on his mind. The palace has not yet decided whether Chức Hà's silk pleases it (V172). He has decided.
